entries.en: Digging is whisker-warping work, as I'm sure you will agree. If one is to keep at it day in and day out, one must have good, nourishing meals.
entries.fr: Excavation user beaucouuup de forces<nbsp>! Besoin de se remplir le ventre ré<->gu<->liè<->re<->ment pour maintenir rythme<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
発掘作業というのは、かなりの重労働でございまする～。
しっかりとこのお勤めをこなすには、
栄養満点の食事が必要でしょ～！

My Chaqurl, in particular, is still a growing boy, and few things please me more than to see his belly full and round.
